title: Television: John Lennon on Un Jour Futur | 1975
content:
John Lennon gave an interview to the French TV show Un Jour Futur on 4 April 1975.

The interview, with Jean-François Vallée, was to promote Lennon’s Rock ‘N’ Roll album, and took place at his recently-vacated apartment at 434 East 52nd Street in Manhattan.

During the interview Lennon performed an impromptu version of LaBelle’s recent hit single ‘Lady Marmalade on an upright piano in the apartment. He also discussed his plans to begin recording a new album on 14 April, although the sessions never took place.
